subject: INV-9981 overdue — AzureWave marketplace payout / VAT hold
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@azurewave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: INV-9981 overdue — AzureWave marketplace payout / VAT hold

Hi Jordan,

Following up on invoice INV-9981 (period: Apr 1–Apr 30). Our records show payment is 45 days overdue. The marketplace report we received shows a payout shortfall and a VAT withholding flagged by your European reseller team. Can you confirm whether AzureWave has initiated settlement with Microsoft Marketplace and whether the VAT reclaim is in process?

I attached the invoice and the marketplace payout extract for your reference. If the shortfall is coming from a chargeback or reversal on the marketplace side we need visibility so we can reconcile on our end and avoid putting the account on hold.

Possible next steps:
- You confirm status with marketplace ops and share expected settlement date.
- If cash will not arrive within 7 days, we escalate to a credit hold and pause API keys (we prefer to avoid this).

Appreciate a quick reply — we have an upcoming quarter-end review and need to close receivables.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: INV-9981.pdf (invoice), marketplace_payout_apr_may.csv (payout extract)

From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@azurewave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marina Gomez <marina.gomez@azurewave.com>, finance@azurewave.com
Date: 2028-05-30T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: INV-9981 overdue — AzureWave marketplace payout / VAT hold

Hi Ben —

Thanks for flagging. We are seeing the same mismatch. Microsoft Marketplace applied a VAT withholding to a batch of partner payouts for EU accounts while they complete a country-level tax validation. That withheld amount includes the payout that would have covered INV-9981. Our finance team is in touch with Microsoft; they estimate resolution in 10–14 business days.

We do not have the funds to settle directly while the marketplace retains the payout, but I can request an interim credit from our treasury team. I will update you by EOD tomorrow with the status.

Jordan
Jordan Li
Head of Partnerships, AzureWave
jordan.li@azurewave.com

--- Original attachments retained ---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T14:22:00Z
Subject: Fwd: INV-9981 overdue — AzureWave marketplace payout / VAT hold

Ben / Aditya —

Looping in finance ops. If Microsoft takes 10–14 business days to release, we should define a temporary dunning cadence and whether we apply a service suspension at day 14 or day 21. My suggestion:

1) Soft dunning (automated reminders) at days 5 and 10.
2) Manual exec outreach + pre-collections notice at day 14.
3) Service suspension (API key pause) at day 21 unless a written settlement plan or partial payment is received.

We should also consider an exception path if the marketplace confirms the hold is their responsibility (i.e., not AzureWave cashflow) — in that case we chase the marketplace and avoid penalizing the customer for things outside their control. Thoughts?

Laura
Director, Customer Success

Date: 2028-06-01T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: INV-9981 overdue — AzureWave marketplace payout / VAT hold

Team —

Finance ops here. Quick notes after reviewing the attachments:
- INV-9981 total due: EUR 82,400. Marketplace payout file shows a EUR 78,900 disbursement for the same period with a EUR 5,500 VAT withholding flagged to "EU_TAX_HOLD".
- There is a shortfall of EUR 3,500 after accounting for fees. Marketplace documents attached indicate Microsoft is the party withholding funds pending verification.

Recommended steps from ops:
A) We can open a paper claim with Microsoft on AzureWave's behalf if they sign an authorization letter (redwood can represent the reconciliation). This typically takes 7–21 days.
B) If AzureWave can provide a written commitment to pay the outstanding EUR 3,500 within 7 business days (and confirm the marketplace reclaim covers the rest on settlement), we can avoid suspension.
C) If neither is possible by 2028-06-08, we should prepare to pause keys and begin a collections workflow.

I would like leadership sign-off to execute A) (authorization to engage Microsoft) and to proceed with C) if no commitment by the deadline.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Finance Operations Manager

On May 30, 2028, at 02:22 PM, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-06-03T09:30:00Z
Subject: Exec approval request — INV-9981: authorization to engage Microsoft & credit-hold timeline

Evelyn / Leadership —

Summary: AzureWave (EU entity) has an unsettled marketplace payout that resulted in an outstanding invoice (INV-9981) for EUR 82,400. Microsoft has flagged a VAT hold covering a large portion of the payout; AzureWave reports marketplace resolution in ~10–14 business days. Finance ops recommends we either:

1) Accept an authorization to pursue the marketplace reclaim on AzureWave's behalf (requires leader approval to contact Microsoft and act as agent).
2) If no written commitment or partial settlement is received by 2028-06-08, apply a pause to production API keys (service suspension) on 2028-06-11 and commence formal collections (outreach to legal and external collections).

Request: approval to:
- Execute option (1) immediately and sign authorization form (attached signed_SOW_AzureWave.pdf for reference).
- Confirm the service suspension timeline above as fallback.

Rationale: engaging Microsoft proactively shortens reconciliation time and protects our revenue; the authorization is a standard reconciliation workflow used with other marketplace partners.

Please reply with: APPROVE / REJECT / MODIFY and any comments.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: signed_SOW_AzureWave.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T16:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — INV-9981: authorization to engage Microsoft & credit-hold timeline

APPROVE.

Ben — proceed to obtain the signed authorization from AzureWave and open the reclaim with Microsoft immediately. Laura, coordinate the dunning cadence and draft the pre-collections notice to be sent on 2028-06-09 if we have no firm payment date. Aditya — prepare the suspension checklist and legal handoff so we can pause keys on 2028-06-11 if necessary.

One caveat: do not suspend production if AzureWave provides a documented marketplace timeline and Microsoft confirms the reclaim is in process. We want to avoid suspension for marketplace timing issues where possible.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
